Name: Tidy Social
Author: trashcan9
Description:
This mod simplifies the social page and birthday calendar by not showing unmet NPCs or by limiting NPC display based on hearts.

[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Show only NPCs you have met on the Social Page.
[*]Show only NPCs you have met on the Calendar.
[*]Optionally, hide NPCs based on heart level.
[/list]

[size=5]Recommended Mods[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16236]NPC Map Locations - Extra Config[/url]: Tidy Social pairs well with the NPC Map Locations - Extra Config mod, which cleans up the NPCs on the map similarly based on whether an NPC is unmet or based on hearts.
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install requirements listed above under Requirements.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. If there are issues, please report them.
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7495]Show Birthdays[/url]﻿ mod.
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]Configuration options allow you to modify setting. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to adjust config in game.
[/list]

[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[list]
[*]None currently.
[/list]
